title: Refilling of Lake Victoria
summary: Lake Victoria is described as having widely dried out about 18 to 17 thousand years ago, while the timing of its refilling (16 to 13 ka) is highly contested. A 2024 study of a central-basin core reports wetlands there before about 16.7 ka, rising water after about 14.0 ka and a lake more than 50 m deep by about 13.5 ka, reaching modern or higher levels around 10.8 ka.

uncertainty.note: Refilling timing is contested; the id says 15 ka. Years are ka counted back from the present as the sources state them.
